artifact_resolution: Artifact paths are relative to the study package. For path p, resources[p] in the index gives its SHA-256 and archive key. archives[resources[p].archive].reference identifies the Hugging Face dataset, immutable revision, archive path and SHA-256; archives[resources[p].archive].records[p] pins the member bytes. Use replica.studies.records.resources.resource_file with this study name and p.
generation_status: The index identifies retained bytes. This record supplies checked derivations below, not a complete account of the original experiments. Original model revisions, generation commands, random-state records and full environments are not established for the retained estimates, runtime measurements or variance samples.

fold_regeneration.recipe: For each language, form the corpus/estimator complete-case intersection after study frame preparation. Sort unique obs_id values, sample without replacement with R set.seed(250), then cycle fold labels 1 through 10.
fold_regeneration.scope: Verified regeneration of the five estimator-specific maps. It does not establish the original generation of the retained reference folds or upstream predictor values.

priority_derivation.mapping: Exact model_ia == text_unit within language; repeated score forms asserted identical including missingness. No token normalization or positional join. Missing exact forms remain NaN. German study code ge maps to store language de.

predictor_store.file_resolution: Each file key is relative to this dataset repository at the recorded revision; sha256 hashes the downloaded file bytes.
limitations: Historical priority tags have no code_commit, model_revision or source_sha256; tags state provenance=records. Hub revision, file hashes, tag metadata and pool fingerprints pin retained inputs, not the original compute implementation.
Unmatched exact forms listed under priority_derivation.unmatched_keys remain NaN.
Generic historical mmc_unigram_surprisal differs numerically from data/mmc_pathwise_estimates.parquet even on matching position and text, and is not interchangeable.

variance_replay.member_resolution: Use the archive bound to sample_resource in artifact_index; its records map gives each listed member checksum.
variance_replay.scope: The bundled replay reproduces ten printed NMC/pathwise variance values from retained per-sample inputs using the documented word-count conversion. Five EE values are retained table references; their per-sample inputs have not been located.

reference_fixtures.generation_status: These checksums identify the retained reference tables. Original table-generation commands and complete environments are not supplied here.

extracted_means.recipe: Grid sp1_ou0_lg0; gaze_rt; nmc/mmc/pmmc; exclude All; scalar surp shared by both conditions; other means read from comps[comparison][est/corpus].mean
extracted_means.scope: Extraction of retained grid summaries; it does not establish how their original model fits were generated.
